text: Archetype [Gr. arch , chief, + tnpoV , form]: Ger. Archetyp , Urbild ; Fr. archétype ; Ital. archetipo . A Platonic word meaning the perfect or absolute idea (cf. PLATONISM, and IDEALISM) of each thing after its kind. See references to Plato ( Republic , Jowett's trans., vi. 507, and ibid. v. 472, and others in Fleming-Calderwood, Vocab . of Philos ., sub verbo). ( J.M.B .)
